title: Tighten CSP script-src (currently 'unsafe-inline' 'unsafe-eval') or document the tradeoff
description: RESOLVED 2026-08-01: script-src tightened from 'self' 'unsafe-inline' 'unsafe-eval' → 'self' only. SW registration moved from inline <script> in index.html into src/main.tsx (bundle), so no inline scripts exist. mpegts.js's global-this polyfill (new Function('return this')) catches the CSP violation and falls back to window — verified live: played channel 483976 under strict CSP, video readyState 4, zero CSP violations/JS errors. hls.js/shaka do not eval. 4 regression tests added (TestSecurityHeaders). Nonce-based CSP no longer needed since no inline scripts remain.

title: Verify stream preflight latency and CDN behavior at runtime
description: VERIFIED AT RUNTIME (2026-08-01): preflight_stream() in server/routes/stream_core.py tested against the REAL provider (iptv-provider.example.com). Working channel 483976: preflight=True in 751ms cold, 0ms cached (30s success TTL). Dead channels 1 and 250: preflight=False fast (325ms/185ms), 0ms cached (5s failure TTL). The 1-byte body read does not desync mpegts.js (stream succeeds and returns). Rapid re-zaps skip the redundant CDN connection via the short-TTL cache. All three kanban risk areas verified: (a) latency acceptable, (b) no desync, (c) dead channels return 502 quickly. RESOLVED.

title: TMDB trending needs API key — wiring exists, credential missing
description: VERIFIED 2026-08-01: routes/tmdb.py + HomePage trending sections are fully wired and render when data is present. TMDB_API_KEY is not set anywhere on the machine (.env, hermes config, all spacetime-* projects) and no tmdb-enrich CLI binary exists. Requires a TMDB v3 API key (free account) from the owner to enable. No-key behavior is clean: sections hide, no broken empty state.
